text: abdomen: The liver is enlarged and contains multiple hypoattenuating lesions in both lobes, the largest measuring 4 cm in segment 7, consistent with metastatic disease. The gallbladder, pancreas, spleen and adrenal glands are unremarkable. Both kidneys enhance normally without hydronephrosis. No ascites or free air. No enlarged retroperitoneal lymph nodes.
